Name: Cash for Trash by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]🗑️💰 [b]Cash for Trash[/b] By[b] Hemptress  💰 🗑️[/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Stop throwing money away.[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Ever accidentally hover a valuable stack over the inventory trash can and think:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]“Why am I throwing this away when Pierre would literally pay me for it?”[/b]
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Now you don't have to.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Cash for Trash[/b] transforms Stardew Valley's inventory trash can into an [b]instant selling system[/b].[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Drop a sellable item into the trash and instead of destroying it, you'll immediately receive:
[/color][color=#d4d4d8]💰 100% of its sell value.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
No shipping bin.
No waiting until tomorrow.
No upgrading the trash can.
Just toss it.
Get paid.[/color]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download [b]Cash for Trash[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the ZIP file.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the [b]CashForTrash[/b] folder inside:[/color][/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]Your installation should contain:
[/color]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/CashForTrash/manifest.json[/code][list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Open your inventory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Throw capitalism directly into the trash can.[/color][/*]
[/list]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]✨ HOW IT WORKS
Open your inventory and grab any sellable item or stack.
Move it over the trash can and you'll see a preview of how much you'll receive.
Drop it in.
CHA-CHING. 💰
The item is removed and its full calculated sell value is immediately added to your wallet.
That's it.
Your trash can has entered its capitalist era.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]💯 FULL SELL VALUE
Cash for Trash pays:
[b]100% of the item's normal game-calculated sell price.[/b]
Unlike Stardew Valley's normal trash reclamation system, your payout does [b]not[/b] depend on how far you've upgraded your trash can.
Whether you've got the basic trash can or the fanciest garbage receptacle money can buy:
You get the full value.
Every time.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🧮 USES STARDEW'S ACTUAL PRICE CALCULATION
The mod doesn't simply slap a generic price onto your items.
Cash for Trash uses Stardew Valley's own sell-price calculations.
That means the payout properly accounts for things such as:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]⭐ Item quality[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]👨‍🌾 Relevant professions[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]💰 Profit margin settings[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]📦 Stack quantity[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]🎮 The item's actual calculated sell value[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Trash a whole stack?
You receive the value of the [b]entire stack[/b].
That innocent little trash icon just became a miniature cash register.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]👀 SEE YOUR PAYOUT BEFORE YOU SELL
Hover an item over the inventory trash can and Cash for Trash shows the amount you'll receive.
So you can see exactly what you're about to sell before committing.
No mystery math.
No:
[b]“WAIT. HOW MUCH WAS THAT WORTH?!”[/b]
Just clean, immediate capitalism.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]⌨️ WORKS WITH NORMAL TRASHING TOO
Cash for Trash isn't limited to physically dragging an item onto the inventory trash can.
The mod also supports Stardew Valley's normal disposal functionality, including the standard [b]Delete-key trash shortcut[/b] and other menus that use the game's normal trash system.
If Stardew treats it as standard item disposal, Cash for Trash can turn that disposal into a payout.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🔒 PROTECTED ITEMS STAY PROTECTED
The mod respects Stardew Valley's normal protections.
Items that the game prevents you from trashing remain protected.
Cash for Trash isn't here to help you accidentally vaporize something important for twelve gold and emotional damage.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🚫 ITEMS WITHOUT SELL VALUE
Not everything in Stardew Valley is actually worth money.
If an item does [b]not[/b] have a positive sell value, it can still be discarded normally, but:
You won't receive gold for it.
Cash for Trash only pays you when the item legitimately has value according to the game's pricing system.
So no infinite-gold alchemy from worthless junk.
Pierre would be furious.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]📦 THIS IS NOT SHIPPING
An important distinction:
Cash for Trash sells items instantly. It does NOT ship them.
Selling something through your trash can does [b]not[/b] count as placing that item into the shipping bin.
That means trash-can sales do not automatically provide:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Shipping collection credit[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Shipping-related achievement credit[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Quest progress requiring shipped items[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Other mechanics specifically looking for items sent through the shipping bin[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]If something specifically needs to be [b]shipped[/b], use the shipping bin.
If you just want the money?
🗑️ [b]Yeet responsibly.[/b]
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🌙 NO MORE WAITING UNTIL MORNING
The shipping bin is great.
Except when you need money...
[b]right now.[/b]
Cash for Trash gives you another option.
Need a few hundred gold before Pierre closes?
Sell something.
Inventory full while exploring?
Sell something.
Mining and don't want to abandon valuable loot?
Sell something.
Need emergency seed money?
You already know what to do.
The trash can is now your tiny portable merchant.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🎮 MULTIPLAYER SUPPORT
Cash for Trash retains Stardew Valley's normal wallet behavior, including [b]shared and separate money setups[/b].
For multiplayer games:
Each player who wants full-value trash selling should install the mod on their own computer.
The payout is applied using the game's normal wallet system.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]⚖️ DESIGNED TO BE SIMPLE
Cash for Trash doesn't introduce:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]New currencies[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Skill trees[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Custom shops[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]New items[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Save-specific progression[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Complicated configuration systems[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]It does one thing.
It does that thing very well.
Trash item → receive money.
Beautiful.
[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]🔧 COMPATIBILITY
Cash for Trash should play nicely with most mods because its scope is intentionally small.
However, you should avoid combining it with other mods that significantly modify:
[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Trash-can payouts[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Trash reclamation values[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Inventory disposal behavior[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The same underlying trash mechanics[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Mods attempting to control the same payout system may conflict or produce unexpected results.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0.0+

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]To ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley.[/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]To the creators and contributors of SMAPI[/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Created by Hemptress with the assistance of AI tools.[/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Cash for Trash[/b] was made for players who have reached the point where destroying a valuable item simply because their backpack is full feels like a personal insult.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
If you enjoy the mod, endorsements, comments, feedback, and bug reports are always appreciated.
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Now remember:
Don't throw it away.
SELL IT AWAY.
🗑️💰✨[/color]
